annotations.title: Coal price and waste fee in Poland

description: Use for the average price of a tonne of coal or the waste collection fee, in Poland and by province. Cena węgla finwire (finwire_coal_price_pl) and Opłata za odpady finwire (finwire_waste_fee_pl): annual average price of a tonne of hard coal and monthly fee for sorted waste collection per person in multi-family buildings, Poland and 16 provinces, from Statistics Poland (GUS). Annual averages for a past year, not current shop prices.

region.description: Province slug without diacritics, e.g. mazowieckie, slaskie, kujawsko-pomorskie; default all 16.
